body: Partly built: regenerate recovery codes (POST /twofactor/recovery-codes, RegenerateRecoveryCodes, round 1) and remember this browser (TrustDevices, devices.go, round 2) are done. Missing: an admin reset of another user's factor (nothing in plugin/admin or twofactor), and lifting a Lockout early (locked_until is only cleared by time). Audit 2026-10-05.
